items.title: Subject: Web Reference: 10146815 Enquiry Number: 22124818 Issue: General Kerbing Works Issues You don't often get email from janeandpaulupton@hotmail.com. Learn why this is important Good afternoon, I am writing on behalf of my cousin Emma Aldred-Tow and her family. Emma has MS and has been wheelchair bound for many years. She is also mother to 2 children who have gone through their primary education at their local schools in Benhall. Emma until recently has also been a teacher. She is a highly regarded member of the local community, fundraising for numerous defibrillators for the local community has been her most recent priority along with promoting Accessible Padel in Gloucestershire . She also remains a volunteer helping at the local junior school, reading with the children on a weekly basis. I see Emma regularly and often accompanied her to pick up her children from the school. I am horrified by the state of the pavements from her home to the school and also to her nearest shopping centre Asda!! In this day and age we should be making it easy and accessible for Emma to remain independent and be able to volunteer, shop and socialise without the danger that she puts herself in every time she leaves the house on her own. I would have provided you a video of what her journey is like from her in her wheelchair- it is too heartbreaking to do!! I truly believe that we should be helping these stalwarts of our community instead of making their lives miserable, impossible and life threatening. I am writing this without Emma’s knowledge but I would really like to know what you and the local council are going to do to help her and her family. I know that in the past her younger son has also written to ask for help with the state of the pavements ! Thank you in anticipation of some quick and necessary fixes to the problem her family lives with. Yours sincerely, Jane Upton
